title: Asynchroner Prüflauf
description: As a developer, I want my prompt to be saved immediately while the check runs in the background, so that the interface never blocks.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated developer creates a new prompt
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer submits the prompt and the scan worker picks the job up
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 201 within the latency budget and the version later reaches status APPROVED
and: the status change is recorded in the history
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-016-async-scan.feature: Saving returns immediately and the scan follows

acceptance_criteria.when: the developer submits a new prompt
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 201 and the prompt is stored
and: the version stays PENDING or moves to FAILED and the developer sees a retry option
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-016-async-scan.feature: An unavailable AI service does not break the write path

acceptance_criteria.given: several scan jobs are queued and the worker is restarted
acceptance_criteria.then: all queued jobs are processed in their original order
and: no job is lost and no version stays in SCANNING forever
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-016-async-scan.feature: A worker restart does not lose queued jobs
